geopolitics_summary: EU leaders divided on energy prices and budget; Von der Leyen proposes strategic gas reserves amid winter supply concerns; Russia–Slovakia ties emerging risk.

themes.headline: Von der Leyen proposes EU-wide strategic gas reserves for winter
themes.why_it_matters: Strategic reserves policy signals demand-side intervention to ease winter storage concerns. If adopted, reduces near-term TTF upside; hedges against supply disruption. Direct EU gas infrastructure play.

themes.headline: Russia plans revival of ties with Slovakia under PM Fico
themes.why_it_matters: Slovakia is key EU gas transit hub; Fico rapprochement with Putin raises risk of disrupted flows or political leverage. Could tighten winter gas supply and elevate TTF volatility. Indirect but material to EU curve.

themes.headline: EU leaders split on energy prices at summit; Costa under fire
themes.why_it_matters: Political fragmentation on energy pricing policy signals weak consensus on price support mechanisms or intervention. Uncertainty on future policy direction affects medium-term power and gas regulatory risk.

themes.headline: Ukraine's refinery strikes threaten Russia oil supply; leverage in Trump talks
themes.why_it_matters: Sustained Ukraine refinery campaign disrupts Russian fuel output, tightening global oil supply. Elevated crude prices increase EU fuel-switching risk into power sector; raises coal and LNG demand indirectly.

themes.headline: EU methane law implementation lags; Brussels and member states trade blame
themes.why_it_matters: Weak methane rule enforcement sustains higher fugitive emissions and leakage in gas supply chain. Could worsen effective supply tightness and elevate TTF risk if LNG suppliers reduce volumes under reputational pressure.

watchlist: EU Council energy price and budget vote outcome over next 2 weeks.
Von der Leyen strategic gas reserve proposal adoption timeline and member state buy-in.
Slovakia–Russia energy negotiations; any gas transit agreement announcements.
Ukraine refinery campaign sustainability; oil supply disruption escalation risk.
